facts.fact: eMarketer forecasts that programmatic ad spending in the United States will reach $81.58 billion in 2021, as cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: It is forecasted that programmatic spending in the United States will reach [$81.58 billion](https://forecasts-na1.emarketer.com/584b26021403070290f93a55/5851918a0626310a2c186aad) in 2021.

facts.fact: StackAdapt advises advertisers to start increasing bids one week in advance of a major sale or event to gain exposure before the rush of ad traffic begins.
facts.quote: It’s wise to start increasing your bids one week in advance to gain additional exposure just before the rush of ad traffic begins.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that an awareness flight run a few weeks ahead of a high-traffic time can make a difference in building recall and generating an audience pool.
facts.quote: Even an awareness flight a few weeks ahead of time can make a difference when building recall and generating an audience pool for future targeting.

facts.fact: StackAdapt recommends increasing the frequency cap in campaigns during peak periods so users see brand messaging more than once, noting high traffic times are short so ad fatigue is less of a concern.
facts.quote: Increasing the frequency cap in your campaigns can help to increase ad exposure so that users will see your brand messaging more than once.

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes peak seasons as tentpole events including back to school, the holidays, and Prime Day, during which consumer spending tends to increase.
facts.quote: During peak seasons, which generally revolve around tentpole events like back to school, the holidays or Prime Day, spending tends to increase.
